$Comment: The first step of Old Jack's questline: bring him Hallowed Pumpkins.
The _Hallows_Eve folder makes the id hallows_eve_old_jack_1. Its Parent, Hallows_Eve_Quest_Base,
keeps the quest off open lists, so it is offered only at Old Jack, and its Season makes it absent
while the event is off. A TURN_IN step is handed in at the giver, so no report-back step is
added. Every step of the questline but the last pays through Hallows_Eve_Chain_Pay, which also
hands over the Lantern Bombs the next step asks the player to throw.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Harvesting XP, the skill the pumpkins come from, paid only where
that mod runs. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server
without it, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Old_Jack_1
